description: This file defines the final class ConnectivityCounterRegistry in the package org.eclipse.ditto.services.connectivity.messaging.monitoring.metrics. It implements a registry for managing counters related to network connection metrics, including initialization, resetting, aggregation, and merging of metrics. The class maintains a thread-safe concurrent map of counters keyed by connection identifiers, metric types, directions, and addresses. It provides methods to retrieve specific counters, aggregate metrics for connections, and handle complex merge operations of metrics responses. The class uses various supporting classes to model metrics data structures, windowed counters, and configuration for monitoring counters.

classes.name: ConnectivityCounterRegistry
classes.description: A thread-safe singleton registry managing counters for network connection metrics, providing init, reset, aggregation, and merging functionalities for metrics related to underlying connections.

classes.name: MapKey
classes.description: Immutable key class used internally in the registry to identify counters based on connection ID, metric type, direction, and address.

methods.name: fromConfig
methods.description: Creates a new registry instance based on the provided monitoring counter configuration.

methods.name: initForConnection
methods.description: Initializes counters for sources and targets of a given connection.

methods.name: resetForConnection
methods.description: Resets counters associated with a specific connection.

methods.name: getCounter
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a counter for given connection ID, metric type, direction, and address.

methods.name: forOutboundDispatched
methods.description: Returns the counter tracking outbound dispatched messages for a specific connection and target.

methods.name: forResponseDropped
methods.description: Accessors for various specific counters like response dropped, acknowledged, etc.

methods.name: aggregateMetrics
methods.description: Combines multiple address metrics into a single address metric.

methods.name: mergeRetrieveConnectionMetricsResponse
methods.description: Merges two response objects into a single response containing all combined metrics.

methods.name: aggregateConnectionMetrics
methods.description: Creates a combined ConnectionMetrics object from source and target metrics.
